cases.question: What changes in a Campaign involving Imperial defenders or a Citizen attacking another Imperial player?
cases.fixed_expected_answer: Citizen attacker against Chancellor/Citizen is non-Imperial for that Campaign; If Chancellor chooses Citizen as defender, that Citizen is non-Imperial during this Campaign. Imperial defender gets Chancellor automatically as Ally; non-attacker Citizens may join with permission if pawn at targeted site or attacker site. Activate defender/allies modifiers, share side powers and battle plans, one use per plan paid by user, never another’s advisers; qualifying allied board warbands defend. Chancellor chooses losses; survivors at sites go Chancellor board, Citizens keep own board survivors. Declared defender decides contested timing/order. Oathkeeper defense bonus shared even non-Supremacy.

required_facts.expected_fact: A Citizen attacking Chancellor/another Citizen is non-Imperial for that Campaign; if Chancellor chooses a Citizen as defender, that Citizen is non-Imperial during it.
Imperial defender automatically gets Chancellor Ally; other non-attacker Citizens may join with permission and pawn at attacker/targeted site.
Activate defender/allied modifiers and applicable shared title defense bonus, including non-Supremacy.
Defender/Allies may use plans at Imperial sites/own advisers, not others’ advisers; each plan once total per Campaign by one user who pays its cost.
Allied board warbands defend only if pawn at attacker/targeted site.
Chancellor chooses defending losses; surviving site warbands go Chancellor board, Citizen-board survivors stay there.
Applicable powers are shared across the defending side, as clarified by errata; declared defender decides contested timing/order/shared-power user.

cases.semantic_notes: Preserves established seed requested scope; equivalent unambiguous meaning accepted, no cross-question borrowing. Single user and once total are distinct. Title bonus can be conveyed by all relevant modifier activation plus side sharing. Payer relationship must be clear; paid-for user alone was independently unresolved. Own-site/board language is explanatory, not a new vocabulary test.

raw_entry.answer: When an Imperial player defends, Chancellor automatically allies; other non-attacking Citizens may join with defender permission if their pawn is at attacker or targeted site. All relevant modifiers and side powers are shared; each ally’s board force defends only if their pawn is at attacker/targeted site. Plans may come from Imperial sites and each user’s advisers, not other players’ advisers; each shared plan can be used once total and paid by its user. Chancellor chooses Imperial defending casualties; surviving site warbands go to Chancellor’s board and surviving Citizen-board warbands stay there. A Citizen attacking Chancellor/another Citizen, or Chancellor attacking a Citizen, is temporarily non-Imperial for that Campaign only.
verbatim_passages: **Imperial defense:** apply every relevant change below.

1. **Choose defender:** any other player who rules your site or whose pawn is there. If no player rules your site, you may choose bandits. A Citizen attacking Chancellor/another Citizen is non-Imperial for that Campaign. If Chancellor attacks Citizen, that Citizen is non-Imperial for it.
2. **Declare targets, form pools:** at least one target must be at your pawn's site; if defender rules that site you **must** target it. May target any of defender's sites anywhere on map (1 defense die each). If defender's pawn is at your site, may also target any of their relics (printed defense dice), banners (dice equal resources on banner), or pawn-and-favor together (2 dice). A co-located defender's relic target satisfies the local-target requirement. Attacker chooses up to as many attack dice as warbands in attacking force. Apply relevant modifiers and mandatory title defense bonus: Oathkeeper +1 defense die, Usurper +2. The mandatory title bonus is itself a Campaign modifier.
3. **Battle plans:** red boxes are attacker-only, blue defender-only, gradient either. Attacker chooses eligible ruled plans once each, then defender chooses eligible ruled plans. Plans at a site require rule, not merely pawn presence; bandits use all ruled plans with no cost. A plan can be paid for even with resources on it, but still only used once per Campaign. If an attack die must be removed from an empty attack pool, add a defense die instead.
4. **Roll defense:** shields rolled, doubled for each double-symbol (multipliers stack ×2, ×4, ×8...), **plus** all defending warbands at targeted sites, **plus** defender's board force if their pawn is at attacker site or any targeted site. Doubles multiply shields only, not warbands. Bandits add 1 per targeted bandit site.
5. **Roll attack:** each skull immediately kills 1 own force warband. Count full swords; each pair of hollow swords adds 1, leftover single adds zero. May sacrifice own surviving force warbands for +1 attack each, but if sacrificing must sacrifice **exactly enough to win**, never excess. Attacker wins only if attack **strictly exceeds** defense; tie or lower means defender wins.
6. **Resolve defeat before taking targets:** on attacker victory, the defender first kills half of the warbands in its defending force, rounded down, returning the rest to board. On defender victory, the attacker kills half its remaining attacking force, rounded down, leaving the survivors on its board; bandits cannot be killed and go into hiding. Resolve defeated battle-plan effects. With Imperial defenders Chancellor chooses which warbands die; surviving site warbands go to Chancellor's board, while surviving warbands already on Citizens' boards stay there.
7. **If attacker won:** may place any number, including **zero**, of surviving force warbands on any targeted sites. Zero leaves site to bandits unless another power applies. Take **all** targeted relics/banners. For a seized banner (taken any way except Recover), burn 2 of its resources to minimum 1; People's Favor flips to Mob. If pawn-and-favor targeted, may force defender to travel to a legal chosen site for no Supply, and independently may burn half their board favor, rounded down. Respect site travel restrictions. **Shrouded Wood overrides the attacker’s destination choice** if its enemy ruler chooses where the pawn must go.
8. **Finish battle-plan effects for either winner:** defeated effects occur immediately after defeat casualties (step 6). If attacker won, resolve targets (step 7), then attacker’s victorious effects. If defender won, skip attacker’s targets but still resolve defender’s victorious effects. Finally, discard any plans from either side that say “At end, discard.” A victorious defender gains no declared targets merely by defending. Transfer Supremacy title **at end of Campaign**, not during temporary loss of site rule.

cases.question: In later-game setup with five players, how much favor goes in each bank, what is on the banners, and what resources and warbands start on each kind of player board?
cases.fixed_expected_answer: Four favor per suit bank (three with two–four players). People’s Favor normal with one favor, Darkest Secret one secret. Chancellor two favor,one secret,three purple board warbands; other players one favor,one secret,three board warbands (own color Exile,purple Citizen). All full Supply.

required_facts.expected_fact: People’s Favor normal with one favor; Darkest Secret with one secret.
Chancellor: two favor, one secret, three purple board warbands.
Other players: one favor, one secret, three own-color Exile/purple Citizen board warbands.

contextual_exclusions.key_or_source_fact: Three favor per bank with two–four players.
contextual_exclusions.rationale: The scenario has five players; other player-count setups are context.
contextual_exclusions.contradiction_policy: Absence alone is not penalized; any volunteered materially false ruling is still incorrect.

raw_entry.question: In later-game setup with five players, how much favor goes in each bank, what is on the banners, and what resources and warbands start on each kind of player board?
raw_entry.answer: Five players means 3 favor in each suit bank (4 each only with 5–6 players, so here 4). People’s Favor starts normal with 1 favor; Darkest Secret with 1 secret. Chancellor starts full Supply, 2 favor, 1 secret, 3 purple board warbands. Each Exile/Citizen starts full Supply, 1 favor, 1 secret, 3 board warbands (Exile own color, Citizen purple).
